## 5 days in Dubai: the Creek, skyline and desert

Canonical URL: https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-5-day-itinerary.html
Reviewed: 2026-10-30

Five full days give you time for Old Dubai, Downtown, the waterfront and one desert outing. Use one hotel base and keep arrival and departure travel outside these sightseeing days.

### The route at a glance

| Day | Plan | Sleep |

| 1 | Al Fahidi, the Creek and souks | Dubai |

| 2 | Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall | Dubai |

| 3 | Marina and JBR | Dubai |

| 4 | Palm Jumeirah or a personal-interest day | Dubai |

| 5 | A desert outing, with a slow morning | Dubai |

### Day 1: start by the Creek

Spend the morning in Al Fahidi, then choose a museum or a longer lunch before crossing the Creek. The [Old Dubai guide](https://www.dxbflights.info/old-dubai-souks.html) connects the Textile Souk, abra journey and Deira’s Spice and Gold Souks without treating them as separate trips.

Leave room to look around. If the heat is tiring, shorten the walk and save the Deira side for later in the day. Do not add Downtown just because it is your first evening.

### Day 2: Downtown, with one main booking

Book the [Burj Khalifa observation experience](https://www.dxbflights.info/burj-khalifa-visit.html) that actually interests you, then build the day around its time slot. [Dubai Mall](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-mall-guide.html) is next door, but its size makes it a destination in its own right. Choose a specific indoor attraction, a meal or shopping time.

If sunset is the main attraction, leave the earlier afternoon flexible. There is no need to squeeze in another observation deck on the same day.

### Day 3: Marina and JBR

Use the [Marina and JBR guide](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-marina-jbr.html) to distinguish the marina promenade from the beach side. Start with the part you most want to see, take a proper break and walk later when it is cooler.

A beach morning and a waterfront dinner can be a complete day. Check what your hotel includes before paying for another beach venue.

### Day 4: the Palm, or a different interest

[Palm Jumeirah](https://www.dxbflights.info/palm-jumeirah-guide.html) works as a view-and-beach day or a full water-park day. Pick one of those versions. A resort at the end of the crescent is not a quick stop between other districts.

If the Palm is not your priority, use this day for [Dubai Frame](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-frame-guide.html) and time nearer the old city, or a [Sharjah art and heritage visit](https://www.dxbflights.info/sharjah-city-guide.html). Museum of the Future’s exhibitions were temporarily closed when we checked on 30 October 2026; read its [current-status guide](https://www.dxbflights.info/museum-of-the-future-guide.html) before making plans.

### Day 5: a desert afternoon

Keep the morning free, then take a [booked desert outing](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-desert-safari-guide.html) suited to your group. Compare what the operator actually includes: driving, conservation, dinner and pickup arrangements vary.

For a history-focused alternative, choose [Mleiha](https://www.dxbflights.info/mleiha-desert-guide.html). Camel racing at [Al Marmoom](https://www.dxbflights.info/al-marmoom-camel-racing.html) needs a confirmed race date and an early start; use it instead of another activity rather than automatically adding it to a late safari day.

### Make the plan fit your dates

In summer, make indoor stops and rest the centre of the afternoon. With children, keep one main booking per day. If you have only five calendar days including flights, remove a sightseeing day instead of borrowing time from airport travel.

For seven full days, add [two days in Abu Dhabi](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-7-day-itinerary.html). Check [hotel areas](https://www.dxbflights.info/where-to-stay-in-dubai.html) before booking, and arrange [mobile data](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-sim-esim.html) so maps and pickup messages are ready on arrival.

### Sources

- [Visit Dubai: neighbourhoods](https://www.visitdubai.com/en/explore-dubai/dubai-neighbourhoods)
- [At the Top: official booking](https://ticket.atthetop.ae/)
- [Museum of the Future: current visitor status](https://museumofthefuture.ae/en)

---

## 7 days in Dubai and Abu Dhabi

Canonical URL: https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-7-day-itinerary.html
Reviewed: 2026-10-30

Use five days in Dubai and two in Abu Dhabi, with an overnight stay in the capital. If you would rather keep one hotel, choose a Dubai-only version with Hatta or Sharjah as a replacement day.

### The route at a glance

| Day | Plan | Sleep |

| 1–5 | Follow the five-day Dubai route | Dubai |

| 6 | Transfer to Abu Dhabi; mosque and a relaxed evening | Abu Dhabi |

| 7 | Louvre and Saadiyat, or a full Yas day | Abu Dhabi or Dubai, according to your flight |

### Days 1–5: let each part of Dubai have its day

Follow the [five-day Dubai plan](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-5-day-itinerary.html): Old Dubai, Downtown, Marina/JBR, the Palm or a personal-interest day, then a desert outing. Put the more tiring activity before a lighter day if that suits your group.

A week does not require seven days of paid attractions. A slower beach morning or a repeat visit to a neighbourhood you enjoyed is often the most useful space in the plan.

### Day 6: move to Abu Dhabi

Travel after breakfast, leave luggage at your accommodation where arranged, and use your booked visitor slot for Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Check its dress and visitor guidance before leaving. Our [Abu Dhabi guide](https://www.dxbflights.info/abu-dhabi-city-guide.html) explains how the mosque fits with the other main sights.

Spend the later part of the day on the Corniche or over a meal. If you want Qasr Al Watan as well, check the actual journey and opening window; move it to tomorrow if the day is becoming a sequence of deadlines.

### Day 7: a museum and island day, or Yas

For art and architecture, give Louvre Abu Dhabi a substantial part of the day and keep any [Saadiyat beach visit](https://www.dxbflights.info/abu-dhabi-islands-guide.html) optional. For a park trip, use the whole day on [Yas Island](https://www.dxbflights.info/yas-island-guide.html) instead. These are two different versions of the day.

This plan assumes you can travel the following day. If your return flight is on day 7, work backwards from the airport deadline and shorten the programme. For a Dubai departure, arrange the return transfer with enough margin rather than planning a park closing time immediately before the drive.

### A week without changing hotels

Keep Dubai as your base and replace the Abu Dhabi portion with a [Hatta day](https://www.dxbflights.info/hatta-day-trip.html) and a [Sharjah city day](https://www.dxbflights.info/sharjah-city-guide.html). Both require planned transport, but neither requires a new hotel. Another option is one organised Abu Dhabi day trip and one free day.

For quieter desert scenery, swap a conventional safari for [Mleiha](https://www.dxbflights.info/mleiha-desert-guide.html). For a confirmed early camel race, use [Al Marmoom](https://www.dxbflights.info/al-marmoom-camel-racing.html) as the morning’s main event. Do not promise yourself all these alternatives within the same week.

### Summer and families

Choose indoor attractions for the middle of summer days and allow recovery time after an outdoor outing. Families can keep the same route with fewer stops, rather than needing a second, busier itinerary.

If the mountain, oasis and smaller-emirate visits are what interest you most, use the [two-week UAE route](https://www.dxbflights.info/uae-2-week-itinerary.html) and spend fewer days on Dubai’s headline attractions.

### Sources

- [Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque: visits](https://www.szgmc.gov.ae/en/visiting-the-mosque/visitors)
- [Louvre Abu Dhabi: plan a visit](https://www.louvreabudhabi.ae/visit-us)
- [Yas Island](https://www.yasisland.com/)

---

## 2 weeks in the UAE: a route beyond Dubai

Canonical URL: https://www.dxbflights.info/uae-2-week-itinerary.html
Reviewed: 2026-10-30

This route uses several overnight bases rather than returning to Dubai after every outing. It assumes 14 full days on the ground, with arrival before day 1 and departure after day 14. Shorten it if your flights fall inside those days.

### The route at a glance

| Day | Plan | Sleep |

| 1–4 | Dubai: old city, Downtown, waterfront and desert | Dubai |

| 5–7 | Abu Dhabi: mosque, museum and island or park day | Abu Dhabi |

| 8 | Al Ain: oasis and a heritage stop | Al Ain |

| 9–10 | Fujairah, Khorfakkan and the east coast | East coast |

| 11–12 | Ras Al Khaimah: heritage and Jebel Jais | Ras Al Khaimah |

| 13 | Umm Al Quwain and/or Ajman | Ajman or Sharjah |

| 14 | Sharjah city, then return to Dubai | Dubai |

### Sort the route before the bookings

Use a car or arranged transfers for the multi-emirate portion. Confirm rental conditions, permitted roads and parking before choosing accommodation. This is a UAE route; keep your navigation on UAE roads unless you have separately planned an international crossing.

For the Dubai portion, Metro, taxis and booked transfers can be simpler than keeping a car throughout. Travellers who do not want to drive can keep Dubai and Abu Dhabi as two bases and book selected excursions, removing the northern loop. That is a different, slower version of the trip.

### Days 1–4: Dubai

Use one day for [the Creek and souks](https://www.dxbflights.info/old-dubai-souks.html), one for [Burj Khalifa](https://www.dxbflights.info/burj-khalifa-visit.html) and [Dubai Mall](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-mall-guide.html), one for [Marina and JBR](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-marina-jbr.html) or [the Palm](https://www.dxbflights.info/palm-jumeirah-guide.html), and one for a [desert outing](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-desert-safari-guide.html).

This is a shorter Dubai stay than the [five-day plan](https://www.dxbflights.info/dubai-5-day-itinerary.html). Choose Marina or the Palm if your days are filling up. If camel racing is a priority, confirm the [Al Marmoom schedule](https://www.dxbflights.info/al-marmoom-camel-racing.html) and reorganise around that morning.

### Days 5–7: Abu Dhabi

Travel to [Abu Dhabi](https://www.dxbflights.info/abu-dhabi-city-guide.html) on day 5 and keep the mosque as the main visit. Use day 6 for Louvre Abu Dhabi and a slower Saadiyat afternoon, or substitute Qasr Al Watan. Day 7 is for [Yas Island](https://www.dxbflights.info/yas-island-guide.html) or a [Jubail mangrove outing](https://www.dxbflights.info/abu-dhabi-islands-guide.html).

Choose the third day according to your interests. It can also be a rest day. Do not add Sir Bani Yas to this city stay without arranging separate travel and accommodation.

### Day 8: Al Ain

Travel to [Al Ain](https://www.dxbflights.info/al-ain-guide.html) and choose an oasis walk and one fort or museum. A Jebel Hafit drive is optional if there is enough daylight and energy. Stay overnight rather than driving straight through to the east coast.

If the oasis is your priority, reach Al Ain the previous evening or move the walk to early day 9. That reduces the programme for the following day, which is preferable to walking at an uncomfortable time simply to keep a timetable.

### Days 9–10: Fujairah and Khorfakkan

Use day 9 for travel and a modest [Fujairah heritage or coastal visit](https://www.dxbflights.info/fujairah-guide.html). On day 10, choose [Khorfakkan and Al Rafisah](https://www.dxbflights.info/khorfakkan-shees-guide.html), or a booked sea activity and an easy afternoon. Stay in one east-coast hotel for both nights.

Shees can replace another stop if the mountains appeal. Read the [wadi guide](https://www.dxbflights.info/uae-wadis-guide.html) before planning any valley walk. Wadi Wurayah is not included because it is normally closed to the public.

### Days 11–12: Ras Al Khaimah

Travel to [Ras Al Khaimah](https://www.dxbflights.info/ras-al-khaimah-guide.html) in daylight. Use the rest of day 11 for one coastal or heritage stop, such as Jazirat Al Hamra. Give day 12 to the Jebel Jais mountain road and a booked activity if you want one.

Dhayah Fort can replace another heritage stop. It does not need to be added to the end of a long mountain day. Keep the outdoor schedule flexible for weather and access conditions.

### Days 13–14: smaller coastal stops, then Sharjah

On day 13, choose an [Umm Al Quwain mangrove outing](https://www.dxbflights.info/umm-al-quwain-guide.html) or [Al Zorah in Ajman](https://www.dxbflights.info/ajman-guide.html). Both may fit geographically, but two water activities are not necessary. Add a museum or a relaxed meal instead. Stay in Ajman or Sharjah.

Use day 14 for [Heart of Sharjah and one art or lagoon stop](https://www.dxbflights.info/sharjah-city-guide.html), then return to Dubai. Sleep near the part of Dubai that suits your next day’s departure. If you fly on day 14, remove the Sharjah sightseeing and prioritise the airport journey.

### What to swap, rather than add

[Mleiha](https://www.dxbflights.info/mleiha-desert-guide.html) can replace a Dubai desert excursion or one east-coast day. [Liwa](https://www.dxbflights.info/liwa-desert-guide.html) needs a more substantial change: exchange some northern nights for a desert stay. [Hatta](https://www.dxbflights.info/hatta-day-trip.html) can replace another mountain outing.

This loop is best suited to the cooler part of the year. In summer, reduce the outdoor circuit and give more time to indoor city visits and rest. The aim is to enjoy the places you choose, not to tick off all seven emirates at any cost.
